name: icmp-canary
description: Reports ICMP echo and other request messages reaching the host (ping sweeps, host discovery). Never sends packets.
author: TrueSignal
documentation: Uses a raw ICMP socket: runs as UID 0 with every capability dropped except NET_RAW, host network, read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges. IPv6 is used when available.

config.name: TS_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Minimum seconds between events per source (suppressed packets are counted)

config.name: TS_IPV6
config.description: Also listen for ICMPv6 echo requests and node information queries

triggers.name: icmp_scan_received
triggers.description: An ICMP request reached the host
